visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown braids, wearing a patterned white and blue beanie and a bright pink puffer jacket, crouches on a snowy ground near a body of water. She holds a large fragment of clear ice in her hands, looking at it intently. The background is a muted, cold outdoor setting with overcast lighting. (2) The woman, now wearing a black coat and a butterfly hair clip, walks across a vibrant rainbow-painted pedestrian street in an urban area. Passers-by are visible in the background under natural daylight. She then stands in front of a large Starbucks advertisement poster on a glass storefront, pointing at it with a focused expression. (3) Inside a modern cafe, the woman browses shelves filled with various Starbucks mugs in different colors like green, white, and black. She approaches a counter where a young male barista in a green apron stands behind a digital register. The lighting is warm and bright from overhead indoor fixtures. (4) Back outdoors, the woman holds a brown cardboard box with the Starbucks logo. She takes out a white ceramic mug featuring colorful illustrations. A series of close-ups show her finger pointing at specific icons on the mug: a blue whale, red houses, white mountains, and a colorful puffin bird against a bright background.
